description: This Java class 'LinkManager' manages serial and TCP connections, handles threading for communication, and provides methods for connection control, logging, and data unpacking within the project.

classes.name: LinkManager
classes.description: A utility class for managing serial and TCP connections, threading, and communication within the project.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified port and waits for it to be established or times out.

methods.name: LOG_LEVEL
methods.description: Defines the logging level for the connection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the connection based on the provided port, setting up the appropriate connector.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the connection with a specified connection state listener.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command through the connector.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a data packet using the connector.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if the connector has encountered an error.

methods.name: unpackConfirmation
methods.description: Extracts confirmation message from a received message.

methods.name: getDefaultPort
methods.description: Returns the default serial port, or null if none found.
